name: UpBench
description: UpBench is a dynamically evolving benchmark grounded in real jobs from the global Upwork labor marketplace. It evaluates LLM agents' competence, adaptability, and collaboration capacity using expert-constructed rubrics and per-criterion feedback, reflecting real professional standards and financial outcomes.
reputation: A newly introduced benchmark that is notable for grounding evaluation in real Upwork jobs and expert rubrics, but it is not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Benchmark tasks correspond to verified client transactions with expert freelancer evaluation; dynamically refreshed to reflect evolving online work.
